author: Forbes
description:
Is your boss trying to make you quit without actually firing you?
Instead of layoffs, more companies are using subtle tactics to encourage employees to leave on their own. It's called quiet firing—and it can be difficult to recognize until it's already affecting your confidence, career growth, and mental health.
In this episode of Work Hotline, Sho breaks down what quiet firing really looks like, why companies do it, and how you can tell the difference between a temporary rough patch and a workplace that's intentionally pushing you out.
More importantly, we'll discuss what you should do if you think it's happening to you. author: Forbes
description:
Most restaurants choose a wine to match their food. At Saint Urban, they do the exact opposite, designing their entire menu completely backward.

At most elite establishments, wine acts as a supporting character, but at Manhattan’s Saint Urban, Chef Jared Ian Stafford-Hill has flipped this traditional culinary hierarchy entirely on its head. A decade-old vintage cannot be altered, so the kitchen team designs its menu in reverse, building every dish around the immutable characteristics of the wine. Each month, the culinary team aligns their offerings with specific global wine regions and their corresponding seasons. In August, the bright profiles of the South of France inspire a menu rich with ratatouille and eggplant; by November, the focus shifts to Piedmont’s earthy white truffles, followed by Champagne and cold-weather shellfish in February.
